summary: BioLife Solutions filed an 8-K disclosing that the HSR waiting period for its pending acquisition by Repligen expired at 11:59 p.m. ET on September 3, 2026. The July 21, 2026 merger agreement provides for $11.25 cash plus 0.1442 Repligen shares per BioLife share, structured as a two-step reverse subsidiary merger. A special stockholder meeting to adopt the agreement is set for October 5, 2026. Remaining conditions include stockholder approval; watch for deal spread moves and any proxy supplemental disclosures.
